title: Ordinary varying direct image commutes with supplied residue restrictions
statement: Fix a prime l, E=ULift Q_l and f:X→S. Given Base b and normalized Geometry g [def-sp-tower-shriek-data], and any Restrictions rS,rX [def-sfb-diagonal-trace-models], there is a natural isomorphism g.push ⋙ rS.F ≅ rX.F ⋙ diagonalTraceSystemPush l f whose map on each section at each level is heterogeneously the identity. There is no assertion of existence of Restrictions, no Chern datum, no coefficient cone and no completed or derived square.

source.place: paragraph (1), ordinary scalar restrictions before right derivation

proof.text: Use the specified ordinary push evaluation and its identity-on-sections normalization, transported from the generic geometry by g's coordinate equalities. The underlying fields of the supplied restrictions give the common additive section carriers. At level n both Z_l actions are multiplication by the natural-number representative of the residue, so the additive identity and its inverse are linear.

The chart and module-map naturality follow from ordinary evaluation and the restrictions and morphisms fields. For horizontal arrows transpose the supplied generic ordinaryPullTransition through the ordinary system and level adjunctions, using ordinary_unit_evaluation and the adjunction triangle identities. The restrictionPullback_underlying equation identifies this mate with the original horizontal section map. Thus the transitions fields give horizontal naturality. Assemble the level isomorphisms into a natural isomorphism of strict systems, preserving the sectionwise identity.

theorem diagonalTraceVaryingScalarSquare (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    (b : SpTowerShriek.Base l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)))
    (g : SpTowerShriek.Geometry l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) b f)
    (rS : Restriction l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) S)
    (rX : Restriction l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) X) :
    ∃ e : g.push ⋙ rS.F ≅ rX.F ⋙ diagonalTraceSystemPush l f,
      ∀ (M : Systems X (Arings l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) X)) (n : ℕ) (U : S.ProEtᵒᵖ)
        (x : (((g.push ⋙ rS.F).obj M).obj (op n)).obj.obj U),
        HEq (((e.hom.app M).app (op n)).hom.app U x) x
